description: Source code for handling locale name aliases, including functions for reading alias files, managing alias mappings, and expanding locale aliases.

methods.name: _nl_expand_alias
methods.description: Expands a locale alias to its full value by searching alias mappings and files.

methods.name: read_alias_file
methods.description: Reads a locale alias file and updates the alias map.

methods.name: extend_alias_table
methods.description: Doubles the size of the alias map table when needed.

methods.name: alias_compare
methods.description: Compares two alias map entries case-insensitively.
